name: genD
title: Bates and Watts D matrix. The first columns are the Jacobian and the rest are the lower triangle of the second derivatives.

origin.description: Bates and Watts D matrix. The first columns are the Jacobian and the rest are the lower triangle of the second derivatives.
origin.details: Bates and Watts D matrix. The first columns are the Jacobian and the rest are the lower triangle of the second derivatives.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(numDeriv))
func <- function(x) c(x[1], x[1], x[2]^2)
genD(func, c(2, 2, 5))$D

from numderiv import genD
